history.content: Reference check: ISBN-13 computes a checksum by summing digits 0..11 with alternating weights 1 and 3, then the check digit d13 satisfies (10 - (sum mod 10)) mod 10. The variant here simply replaces 3 by some k (2..9) and alternates (1, k). The final digit is not part of the alternating sum. This aligns with the planned calculation. No further constraints noted from references about transposition uniformity across datasets.
